subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 3: Midpoint of a Segment
description: Locate the midpoint of a segment visually on a grid and by using the midpoint formula with endpoint coordinates.
learningObjectives: Identify the midpoint of a segment as the point halfway between two endpoints
Locate a midpoint visually on horizontal, vertical, and diagonal grid segments
Use the midpoint formula to average endpoint coordinates
Solve midpoint problems from endpoint coordinates
Avoid common midpoint mistakes such as averaging the wrong values
prerequisites: Read ordered pairs on the coordinate plane
Add and divide integers and rational numbers
